nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

categoryId.description: Category ID, provide at least one with `keyword`; `0` means all departments, for example `976759_976787`.

keyword.description: Search keyword, maximum length 1024 characters; provide at least one with `categoryId`.

nextDayEnabled.description: Whether to display only NextDay delivery results.

page.description: Pagination page number, the maximum value is `100`.

softSort.description: Whether to sort by relevance; set to `false` to disable.

sort.description: Sort by: `price_low` (price from low to high), `price_high` (price from high to low), `best_seller` (best selling), `best_match` (best match). Uses default relevance ordering when not specified.

storeId.description: Store ID to filter products by a specific store.
